description: Details of Condition 5 'Piling Method Statement' pursuant to planning permission 24/AP/3086 dated 30/01/2025 'Variation of Condition 1 (Approved Plans) to planning application 23/AP/3238 (dated 06/03/2024) 'Demolition of a two-storey dwelling house with an annexed garage and a swimming pool with enclosure. Construction of two-storey dwelling house with basement and a swimming pool to the rear garden. Site wide landscaping (including SuDs) and removal of arboriculture features to facilitate works. Provision of bike and bin storage and installation of ASHPs. Relocation of off-street parking access and installation of boundary treatments.'. Amendments include: (a) Reduced Massing: Removed first-floor projection on the front façade, Recessed building line for both front and rear at ground and first floor levels, Simplified roof form reflecting the reduced massing. (b) Alterations to Glazing: Reduced size of front and rear windows with adjustments to the fenestration layout. (c) Boundary Alterations: Front boundary treatment revised to a maximum height of 1.4m, applied consistently to the bike storage area, Side boundary sections revised from wire mesh to close board fencing, and addition of evergreen screening along garden boundaries. (d) Swimming Pool Siting: Swimming pool relocated from the northern boundary. (e) Swimming Pool Plant: Relocation of the pool plant gear to the under croft beneath the pool. Associated amendments include changes in approved layout, design and material finishes.'.
